title: French teachers and spelling of her name
summary: She learned French from Miss Jarot and the Mazurro sisters, worked for French families, and spells her name Zenon in French.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Oh, you had French teachers? Yes. Did you have sisters?
No, no, it was Miss Jarot, she's dead now. Miss Amanda Jarot.

And then my mother used to work for the Renaissance family. There was two sisters, single. They were the Mazurros then. And I was raised there with them, right there in the house. And when my mother stopped working there, then she put me with me Jarot. For French.
Oh, I see. So you got very good teaching in French.

Oh, yes. Oh, yes. The Miss Mazurros, Miss Jarot. Real French. And then after I left them, I was so Frenchy, I rather work with the French people, you know. I worked with them. It was then French, French, French. Well, I was a big girl. I didn't speak Creole at all. Just French. I went then, I went to work with the Gascones, you know. And, you know, they still didn't know nothing but Creole. And I had to speak French with them. I was born in the city of New Orleans, on St. Claude, between Columbus and Caleric.
But I wanted to get your full name. How do you spell your name? Is it the different French spelling?
Alice. Alice. A-L-I-C-E. Same as English. William. I like William. Alice William.
And the Zeno, does that have an N on the N? Is it Z-E-N-O?
Z-E-N-O. Z-E-N-O. In French, it has an N on the N. But not in English. Not in English. In French, it's Z-E-N-O-N. In English, it's Z-E-N-O.
So you spell it the English way, though, now, right? Hmm? Yeah. You get your mail the English way.
Yes. They don't pronounce Z-E-N-O no more in French. It's just in my christening paper. I believe it's N-O-N. Because it was N. No, it's N-O.
You still have your christening paper?
Oh, me, I had to have my christening paper, yes. I don't know if I got it yet. I think in that envelope.
